@overview 字彙王 Level 3–5 練習題本。答案與中文詞義已與教材官方解答逐題核對；題目文字為照片轉錄。

@group A 文意字彙（1–5）：依提示寫出正確的字

Q 1 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Andy likes to eat lots of fruit and vegetables because they help with his d______n.
= digestion
~詞義 digestion（n.）消化
~原文 Andy likes to eat lots of fruit and vegetables because they help with his digestion.

Q 2 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Tom hasn't come to school for a week. His classmates s______e about the reason, but no one really knows.
= speculate
~詞義 speculate（v.）推測
~原文 Tom hasn't come to school for a week. His classmates speculate about the reason, but no one really knows.

Q 3 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Small babies are easily scared and very v______e, so one must move carefully around them to avoid hurting them.
= vulnerable
~詞義 vulnerable（adj.）脆弱的
~原文 Small babies are easily scared and very vulnerable, so one must move carefully around them to avoid hurting them.

Q 4 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Mandy thinks that the novel is not interesting at all. She cannot stop yawning out of b______m.
= boredom
~詞義 boredom（n.）無聊
~原文 Mandy thinks that the novel is not interesting at all. She cannot stop yawning out of boredom.

Q 5 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The young couple v______wed that they would never mistreat or lie to each other.
= vowed
~詞義 vow（v.）發誓
~原文 The young couple vowed that they would never mistreat or lie to each other.

@group B 選擇題（6–10）

Q 6 | choice | 選擇題
stem: This dish is too hot for me. I am not used to eating ______ food.
A: antique
B: spacious
C: municipal
D: spicy
= D
~詞義 spicy（adj.）香辣的
~原文 This dish is too hot for me. I am not used to eating spicy food.

Q 7 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Environmental groups ______ the company for polluting the river, demanding immediate action and long-term responsibility.
A: conceded
B: condemned
C: specified
D: tormented
= B
~詞義 condemn（v.）譴責
~原文 Environmental groups condemned the company for polluting the river, demanding immediate action and long-term responsibility.

Q 8 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The mechanic ______ the new tires onto the car and checked each bolt to ensure the vehicle's safety.
A: comprised
B: mounted
C: freighted
D: anticipated
= B
~詞義 mount（v.）安裝
~原文 The mechanic mounted the new tires onto the car and checked each bolt to ensure the vehicle's safety.

Q 9 | choice | 選擇題
stem: There is a higher ______ of female leaders in the government now than ever before, but the number could certainly be higher still.
A: appliance
B: dimension
C: entrepreneur
D: proportion
= D
~詞義 proportion（n.）比例
~原文 There is a higher proportion of female leaders in the government now than ever before, but the number could certainly be higher still.

Q 10 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The organization supported international ______ in the crisis to prevent further violence and suffering.
A: intervention
B: speculation
C: prosecution
D: complication
= A
~詞義 intervention（n.）介入
~原文 The organization supported international intervention in the crisis to prevent further violence and suffering.

@group C 配合題（11–15）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: apt
B: compliant
C: compulsory
D: judicial
E: doorway
F: vomited

Q 11 | bank | 配合題
stem: In Taiwan, ______ education requires children to attend school for twelve years.
= C
~詞義 compulsory（adj.）義務的
~原文 In Taiwan, compulsory education requires children to attend school for twelve years.

Q 12 | bank | 配合題
stem: The puppy was surprisingly ______ during training; it followed basic commands after only a few demonstrations.
= B
~詞義 compliant（adj.）服從的
~原文 The puppy was surprisingly compliant during training; it followed basic commands after only a few demonstrations.

Q 13 | bank | 配合題
stem: The people in this country do not trust the ______ system because they think many judges are corrupt.
= D
~詞義 judicial（adj.）司法的
~原文 The people in this country do not trust the judicial system because they think many judges are corrupt.

Q 14 | bank | 配合題
stem: After George stepped off the roller coaster, he ______ into a trash can.
= F
~詞義 vomit（v.）嘔吐
~原文 After George stepped off the roller coaster, he vomited into a trash can.

Q 15 | bank | 配合題
stem: The house is not well heated, and it is ______ to get very chilly on winter evenings.
= A
~詞義 apt（adj.）有…的傾向
~原文 The house is not well heated, and it is apt to get very chilly on winter evenings.

@group C 配合題（16–20）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: torches
B: investigator
C: quest
D: diplomatic
E: sphere
F: prosecutions

Q 16 | bank | 配合題
stem: Recently, there has been an increasing number of ______ related to Internet crime.
= F
~詞義 prosecution（n.）起訴
~原文 Recently, there has been an increasing number of prosecutions related to Internet crime.

Q 17 | bank | 配合題
stem: The Environment Bureau received some complaints about noises in the neighborhood, so they sent a(n) ______ to look into the situation.
= B
~詞義 investigator（n.）調查人員
~原文 The Environment Bureau received some complaints about noises in the neighborhood, so they sent a(n) investigator to look into the situation.

Q 18 | bank | 配合題
stem: The lamp is shaped like a(n) ______. When it glows in the dark, it looks like a floating moon.
= E
~詞義 sphere（n.）球體
~原文 The lamp is shaped like a(n) sphere. When it glows in the dark, it looks like a floating moon.

Q 19 | bank | 配合題
stem: The two countries have maintained close ______ relations for decades; they are strong allies.
= D
~詞義 diplomatic（adj.）外交的
~原文 The two countries have maintained close diplomatic relations for decades; they are strong allies.

Q 20 | bank | 配合題
stem: Last year's silver medalist has entered the competition again. He is on a(n) ______ for the championship.
= C
~詞義 quest（n.）追求
~原文 Last year's silver medalist has entered the competition again. He is on a(n) quest for the championship.
